name_zh: 斯帕克/比利时/联邦/语言/欧盟/北约/首都/布鲁塞尔/斯帕克法则
description_zh: 保罗-亨利·斯帕克 (1899-1972) 比利时首相/欧共体首任主席/北约秘书长，斯帕克法则以渐进妥协推进欧洲一体化，推动罗马条约/欧盟/北约/比利时联邦化，语言社群联邦制平衡法语/荷兰语社群，布鲁塞尔作为欧盟/北约双重首都奠基者。
description_en: Paul-Henri Spaak (1899-1972) Belgian PM/EEC first President/NATO Secretary General, Spaak Method advanced European integration through gradual compromise, drove Rome Treaties/EU/NATO/Belgian federalization, linguistic community federalism balanced French/Dutch communities, Brussels as EU/NATO dual capital founder.
reason_zh: 斯帕克代表小国外交如何通过渐进妥协引领大陆一体化，展示了语言联邦制如何平衡多元族群冲突，其斯帕克法则成为欧盟一体化核心方法论，布鲁塞尔双重首都地位奠定比利时小国大外交地位。
reason_en: Spaak represents how small nation diplomacy leads continental integration through gradual compromise, demonstrating how linguistic federalism balances multi-ethnic tensions, his Spaak Method becoming EU integration core methodology, Brussels dual capital status establishing Belgian small nation big diplomacy status.

expected_en: Master how gradual compromise becomes continental integration core methodology, grasp linguistic federalism resolving ethnic tensions, evaluate Spaak decisive foundational contribution for EU/NATO/Belgian federalization.

case_en: 1957 Rome Treaties; 1967 EEC President; 1972 death. Spaak Method/EU integration/NATO/federalization paradigm endures.
